sloka: कामं हन्तुं समर्थो ऽस्मि सहस्राण्यपि रक्षसाम् ।नतु शक्ष्यामि संप्राप्तुं परं पारं महोदधेः ।। ५.३०.३४।।।।
transliteration: kāmaṁ hantuṁ samartho 'smi sahasrāṇyapi rakṣasām ।natu śakṣyāmi saṁprāptuṁ paraṁ pāraṁ mahodadheḥ ।। 5.30.34।।।।

translations.english: "I may be capable of killing even thousands of demons but thereafter (thoroughly exhausted) reach the other side of the ocean.
